html:
We are a small team that made this short game to practice and demonstrate our skills. Your feedback and experience will help us develop the better games in the future. We hope you enjoy it :)

"An ominous, narrative-driven adventure inspired by H. P. Lovecraft’s “Dagon.” You follow the story of a soldier who escaped captivity aboard a grim military vessel, only to awaken on a nightmarish island where reality becomes a blur. The land defies reason. The air feels wrong. And the truth refuses to reveal itself."

Features

  • Immerse yourself in a slow-burning, atmospheric story

  • Explore the grim unknown world around you

  • Discover the truth behind the isle of flesh
